name: skill-manager
description: Manage the lifecycle of Agent Skills in a central repo. Acquire (fetch a repo, select a subset, dedup by purpose-digest, audit/rename, record provenance, flat-symlink to global/project), recommend skills that fit a project, and organize/dedup what you own. Token-frugal: lexical prefilter + LLM, no vectors. Entry: "install skills from this repo" / "recommend skills for this project".
